@everyone 

Happy Friday all you lovely Cornucopians, 

It has been a long and thorough process of due diligence to ensure that team and advisor token distributions will account for the best interest of our team members and community. As previously mentioned, the majority of our team opted to double their vesting period from 15 months to 30 months. That said, here are some key points to take into consideration about our team's token vesting schedule and distribution method.

-  Team and Advisor tokens begin to vest on March 10, 2023
-  There are various vesting schedules between 15 and 48 months.
-  We are utilizing a smart contract platform to facilitate the movement of tokens to the team/advisors
-  If anyone decides to sell a portion of tokens, we have the option to either (1) buy back the tokens or (2) utilize our market maker to provide a managed selling process.
-  All of the public sale and private sale tokens have fully vested. 
-  Here is a link to our anticipated vesting schedule for the team and advisors. Please note that vesting and actual movement of tokens are not the same.

Schedule: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XUOw8cUXJ20cc_7GXdPl2WcNwwpOKi5ui3aWh96Y5wk/edit?usp=sharing
